counterfactual_paper_transfer.metric_warning: The paper defines target contact as grounding in its simulation benchmark and reports correct-task attempts versus completed executions in its real-world breakdown. In SGW the target is always the same cube, so cube contact alone cannot establish that left/right, higher/lower or relative-distance language was followed. Use the registered relation/trajectory analyses without equating them to the paper's grounding rate.
